items.title: Return the signed field trip form
items.quote: Please return the signed field trip form by Friday, October 23.

items.title: Pay the $12 trip fee
items.quote: The trip fee of $12 is due with the form.
items.note: 'due with the form' names no date: no due date (a model that copies Oct 23 from the previous sentence gets a date error). Deadline: no owner penalty. 0.80 + 0.05 = 0.85, Likely.

items.title: Wear closed-toe shoes
items.quote: Students must wear closed-toe shoes on all trips.
items.note: Standing rule, not a loop. Pass if left out or scored Ignore.
